info.title: Embassies
info.description: Manage diplomatic missions and view embassies or partners recorded for your country. Embassy relations support communication between countries; actions against embassies may affect relations and cooperation.

empty.title: No foreign embassies are registered yet.
empty.description: Build an embassy from a country's details page to start establishing diplomatic relations.

confirm.title: Confirm Embassy Destruction
confirm.message: Are you sure you want to destroy the embassy in {country}? This action cannot be undone and will sever diplomatic relations.

success.title: Success
success.message: The embassy in {country} has been destroyed.
